toolsPreview.name: preview_move
toolsPreview.description: Free no-data preview for moving a harness between any two of the 13 supported tools (Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, OpenClaw, Aider, Continue, Cline, Goose, Zed, Roo Code, ChatGPT, Claude.ai, Copilot). Returns feasibility copy only. Does not accept or return mappings, file paths, generated content, or validation notes.

toolsPreview.name: preview_build_setup
toolsPreview.description: Free no-data preview for building a user's first setup in any of the 13 supported tools. Does not accept GitHub handles, generated memories, mappings, or file content.

toolsPreview.name: list_targets
toolsPreview.description: List Bring Your AI target tools. No harness data is accepted or returned.

toolsPreview.name: install_local_cli
toolsPreview.description: Return no-data local install and MCP wiring commands. The remote server does not install anything and does not receive harness data.

toolsPreview.name: list_products
toolsPreview.description: List agent-readable Bring Your AI products and supported payment modes. No harness data is accepted.

toolsPreview.name: quote_lifetime_license
toolsPreview.description: Quote a Bring Your AI lifetime license or Team Migration Pack in USD. The team pack includes one guided migration and onboarding for up to 10 people plus lifetime licenses.

toolsPreview.name: start_checkout
toolsPreview.description: Start checkout. With payment_mode=stripe_spt plus shared_payment_granted_token and buyer_email, settles a Stripe PaymentIntent and returns the signed license without opening a browser.
